v2_change: Added the HARD INFERENCE-SAFETY / CACHE CONTRACT (applies to L1, B1, B2) and the per-feature FEATURE_PROVENANCE_MANIFEST for the actually-implemented B1.1 features, each carrying the hard-gate booleans. An automated inference-safety audit (leakage test) runs before every LODO/eval and hard-fails on violation.
purpose: Dataset-agnostic per-candidate feature contract for G2 Track-B universal L2 (pool admission B1, then final ranking B2). No dataset IDs, no gold-derived entity links, no supporting-fact/target labels. Every feature has bounded/relative semantics and a deterministic dataset-agnostic abstention rule.

candidate_universe.definition: original P50 scope UNION parameter-free STRUCTURAL directional expansion
candidate_universe.M_note: M_MAX is an upper candidate-GENERATION budget, not the final pool size; no per-dataset M.
candidate_universe.graph_for_mainline: structural / native only (row-space master_nodes.neighbors); kNN graph = ablation only

anchor_policy.seed_resolver: UNIVERSAL, parameter-free, no dataset branch: seed set = retrieval seeds (dense/splade top-k docs) UNION title-match topics (deterministic find_topics). Retrieval seeds guarantee ~100% coverage everywhere.
anchor_policy.rationale: Title-match-ALONE anchor coverage is dataset-correlated (metaqa 1.00 / 2wiki 1.00 / musique 0.67 / squad 0.24) and would leak dataset identity via missingness. Retrieval-seeded anchors are ~1.0 for all datasets, so anchor-present flags do not reveal identity.
anchor_policy.abstention: Every anchor-dependent feature is paired with a binary *_anchor_present flag and uses sentinel 0.0 when the anchor is absent. The learned model always sees the flag; abstention is explicit, never a magic in-band value.

S0_retrieval_relative.abstention: none (retrieval scores present for every candidate in scope)

features.name: dense_rank_pct
features.def: percentile of candidate by dense score within the query scope (1=best)

features.name: splade_rank_pct
features.def: percentile by splade_scope score within scope

features.name: fused_rrf_pct
features.def: percentile by equal RRF(dense,splade), k0=60

features.name: retriever_support_frac
features.def: fraction of {dense,splade} that place candidate in their top-K0 (K0=60)

features.name: dense_splade_agreement
features.def: 1 - |dense_rank_pct - splade_rank_pct| (cross-retriever agreement)

features.name: original_P50_membership
features.def: 1 if candidate in the original P50 scope else 0 (0 only for geometry-added candidates)

features.name: original_fused_rank_pct
features.def: percentile by the base fused pool-selection score within scope

S1_plus_structural.abstention: seed-relative features -> sentinel 0.0 + struct_anchor_present=0 when no seed resolves; degree_pct is anchor-free (available if node in graph, else 0 + node_in_graph=0)
S1_plus_structural.graph: row-space structural adjacency from master_nodes.neighbors (uniform interface; provenance varies by dataset)

features.name: struct_anchor_present
features.def: 1 if >=1 seed resolves into the structural graph

features.name: min_struct_hop_from_seed_norm
features.def: 1/(1+min BFS hop from any seed to candidate), capped at H; 0 if unreachable/no anchor

features.name: seed_connectivity_frac
features.def: fraction of seeds with a path (<=H) to candidate

features.name: struct_support_count_norm
features.def: #seeds structurally adjacent (<=1 hop) to candidate / n_seeds

features.name: ppr_pct
features.def: percentile of candidate PPR mass within scope (restart set = seeds); 0 if no anchor

features.name: degree_pct
features.def: percentile of candidate degree within the query-local graph (anchor-free)

S2_plus_directional_geometry.abstention: directional features -> sentinel 0.0 + dir_anchor_present=0 when no anchor; expansion_hop=0 and expansion_rank_pct degenerate on pure-P50 (no expansion) scopes
S2_plus_directional_geometry.demonstrated_efficacy: Track-A/Q2 established directional s_dir value on MetaQA (entity-anchored) ONLY; text-dataset efficacy via retrieval-seed anchors is UNTESTED and is an explicit B1/Track-A-extension question.

features.name: dir_anchor_present
features.def: 1 if a directional anchor+edge resolves for candidate

features.name: s_dir_max
features.def: max over edges of cos(r_q, norm(x_v - x_e)); r_q = query residual after projecting out seed span

features.name: s_dir_mean
features.def: mean directional compatibility over supporting edges

features.name: s_dir_rank_pct
features.def: percentile of candidate by s_dir within scope

features.name: expansion_hop
features.def: normalized hop at which candidate was reached by directional expansion (0 if in P50)

features.name: expansion_rank_pct
features.def: percentile of candidate by directional expansion score

features.name: n_dir_anchors_supporting_frac
features.def: fraction of anchors whose directional edge supports the candidate

excluded_features: relation TYPE / relation name (metaqa=9, webqsp=6094, others=1 -> reveals identity, non-transferable)
raw corpus-scale scores used as absolute values
gold relations / supporting facts / target labels
any KB-specific path name or freebase predicate
guardrails: true LODO (train all-except-D, hyperparams+normalization on TRAIN only, eval target VAL once)
existing 6 datasets = development/LODO evidence, not final external generalization proof

inference_safety_cache_contract.core_rule: For a completely unseen query Q, every inference feature must be computable from ONLY: (1) Q itself; (2) frozen model parameters; (3) corpus/graph artifacts built before Q arrived and independent of relevance labels; (4) intermediate results produced while processing Q. If a feature cannot be computed when Q is the FIRST EVER query after deployment, it is NOT inference-safe.
offline_cache_allowed: normalization/calibration statistics fit ONLY on permitted TRAIN data
inference_safety_cache_contract.offline_cache_invariant: All offline artifacts must be QUERY-INDEPENDENT and RELEVANCE-LABEL-INDEPENDENT (except legitimate parameters/statistics learned on TRAIN). Caching does NOT make leaked information safe.

normalization.A_TRAIN_FROZEN: fit only on TRAIN datasets in the fold, frozen before target eval
normalization.B_QUERY_LOCAL: computed only over the current query's candidate universe (rank/degree/PPR/direction percentiles)
normalization.FORBIDDEN: target-dataset-wide VAL/TEST normalization statistics; any target calibration

anchors.optional_auxiliary_entity_linker: allowed ONLY if same algorithm/interface across datasets, inference-safe, no target labels, may abstain; if no valid anchor -> fall back to retrieval-seeded

allowed_as_model_input: expansion_hop from our own online traversal
hop_path_safety.note: benchmark hop labels used ONLY for post-hoc evaluation breakdowns

inference_safety_cache_contract.provenance_pass_through: L1 must NOT emit only candidate IDs. For every candidate preserve inference-generated evidence (entered_via_dense/splade/structural_expansion, dense_rank_pct, splade_rank_pct, min_expansion_hop, structural_support, directional_score/rank, supporting_anchor_count, query-local PPR) and pass it to B1/B2. Q2 showed discarding WHY a candidate was retrieved destroys useful signal.
inference_safety_cache_contract.cache_implementation: Distinguish CAN_BE_CACHED from MUST_BE_MATERIALIZED. Normalized edge displacement is inference-safe to cache but do NOT blindly materialize all_edges x 1536; cache node embeddings + adjacency and compute x_v - x_u on demand for traversed edges only. Profile storage/latency before deciding.
inference_safety_cache_contract.ppr: Offline cache may hold adjacency / degree normalization / transition representation, but the personalization/restart vector MUST come from the current query's retrieval seeds. No target-wide precomputed query relevance.
inference_safety_cache_contract.repeated_query_cache: Deployment MAY cache query hash/embedding/retrieval/universe/features/B1-top50/B2-top5, but correctness must never depend on it; scientific evaluation assumes unseen/cache-miss queries; do not report canonical latency from repeated-query hits.
inference_safety_cache_contract.dataset_missingness: No silent dataset-specific replacement of missing features; each universal feature has deterministic abstention semantics; audit whether missingness fingerprints dataset identity; NO `if dataset==...` anywhere in the inference feature path.
inference_safety_cache_contract.hard_gate: Every inference feature must satisfy: uses_gold_labels=NO AND uses_supporting_fact_annotations=NO AND uses_dataset_identity=NO AND uses_target_statistics=NO AND available_for_first_unseen_query=YES.
inference_safety_cache_contract.leakage_test: Before every LODO/full eval run an automated inference-safety audit; FAIL immediately if any inference tensor depends on target labels, target VAL/TEST aggregate statistics, benchmark annotations unavailable for a real unseen query, dataset ID, gold entities/relations/paths, or future queries.

feature_provenance_manifest_B1_1_impleme.note: The ACTUAL 17 features emitted by scratchpad/_b11_build.py (S0=cols0-4, S1=cols5-9, S2=cols10-16). qhop is stored per query for POST-HOC per-hop breakdown ONLY and is never a model input. All features pass the hard gate.
feature_provenance_manifest_B1_1_impleme.normalization_used: model input standardization = TRAIN-FROZEN (mean/std from the fold's source datasets only); all percentile features = QUERY-LOCAL over the current universe. No target-wide statistics.

features.name: min_exp_hop_norm
online: hop at which OUR expansion first reached candidate; 1/(1+hop)
features.note: OUR online traversal hop, NOT benchmark question-hop

features.name: n_struct_anchors_pct
online: #anchor edges into candidate during traversal -> query-local percentile

features.name: struct_dist_pct
online: BFS distance from seeds -> query-local percentile

features.name: dir_support_max_pct
online: max directional support over in-edges -> query-local percentile (abstain=0)

features.name: geometry_added_ind
online: 1 if candidate entered via structural expansion (not in P50)
features.guard: included WITH confidence/context features per contract; geometry provenance alone does not define relevance

evaluation_only_not_a_feature.name: qhop
evaluation_only_not_a_feature.reason: benchmark question-hop; used ONLY for post-hoc per-hop metric breakdown; asserted absent from the model feature matrix by the automated audit
